method: Read-only psql session inside the candidate database container; BEGIN READ ONLY followed by ROLLBACK.
decision: Do not create the analytics login or configure a Metabase source on this target. First resolve the exact-target migration checksum history, apply and review the reporting migration through the tracked runner, then provision a dedicated read-only source role after reviewing all instance database and inherited extension ACLs. The candidate's only login/superuser role is kokonut; the application database grants PUBLIC CONNECT and TEMPORARY.
limitations: This is an ACL inventory, not an authorization test.
No database, role, schema, grant, source, or application data was changed.
The candidate has nine pending migrations and one applied-source checksum mismatch; schema 377 reporting objects are therefore not present.
The migration's explicit PUBLIC revokes apply to kokonut_reporting only and do not by themselves restrict database CONNECT privileges or inherited extension metadata grants.
